articles.title: Deterrent measures against riots
articles.description: This Monday it became known that only two of the 79 minors arrested for the riots on October 24th will not face any precautionary measures. Five have been institutionalized and the vast majority, 72, have been placed under a probation regime. Now the justice system will begin its process so that in some cases those responsible for the minors, whether parents or guardians, may be fined due to the damages caused to public furniture. This action demonstrates that the immediate objective is to dissuade the youngest from participating in protests of this type, organized by someone not yet clearly known nor for what objective, but which led to scenes of looting and urban violence that have caused understandable public alarm.
